The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.
